description: Mark an unpaid order as paid in full by recording one payment equal to its total - manual reconciliation; nothing is charged or verified with a payment provider. Idempotent by reference. Refused for a canceled order, one already paid under another reference or partly paid, or an amount different from the total. For a part payment or the rest of a balance, record_order_payment. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.

amount.description: Amount in minor units of the order's currency (cents); must equal the order's total

reference.description: Payment reference / receipt id; repeating a recorded reference is a no-op

name: mark_order_paid
title: Mark order paid
